parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a convenience store, focusing on multiple refrigerated beverage coolers filled with various drinks. Above the coolers are red promotional posters with Chinese text and images. The perspective is slightly tilted, capturing shelves and glass doors of the coolers, with some motion blur evident.

objects.label: refrigerated beverage cooler
objects.observation: A large, multi-door refrigerator unit with glass doors, stocked with numerous bottles and cans of beverages. Located centrally in the frame, it spans most of the width. The doors reflect light and show internal shelving. Partially obscured by glare and angle.

objects.label: refrigerated beverage cooler
objects.observation: Another tall, glass-door refrigerator to the right, partially visible. Contains beverages on white shelves. Its door handle is visible. Slightly out of focus due to angle and reflection.

objects.label: promotional poster
objects.observation: A red rectangular poster above the central cooler, featuring Chinese characters and an image of a drink bottle. Positioned at top center, partially visible. Text includes '果然好味' and '果然好活力'.

objects.label: promotional poster
objects.observation: A second red poster to the left of the central cooler, showing a beverage advertisement with Chinese text. Partially visible, positioned above the leftmost cooler section. Text includes '时刻纯净 好状态相伴'.

objects.label: shelf with packaged goods
objects.observation: A shelf on the far left holding various packaged items, mostly obscured by angle and motion blur. Appears to contain snacks or small goods. Partially visible behind the left cooler.
